messages:
ada: Heads-up — bringing up Sable21b (21B) int4 canary. Warmstarts show memory fragmentation and intermittent OOMs on tail requests. Logs below.

marcus: got it. which infra pool? dedicated or hosted canary?

ada: dedicated-gpu-us-east-2. small canary (3 pods). failure pattern when multiple concurrent starts + bursty max_new_tokens >=1024.

jing: paste logs

ada: ```
ERROR OOM allocator failed: cannot allocate 512MB
stack: kv_cache_alloc at runtime.cc:412
prefetch: requested 1.2GB but only 800MB free
``` 

leo: sounds like KV cache priming + prefetch overcommit. we saw similar with orca variants.

silvia: quick mitigation: lower default max_new_tokens to 512 for canary, set prefetch=false, reserve 2 slots for warmstart. canary config snippet:

ada: ```json
{"max_new_tokens":512, "prefetch_enabled":false, "slot_reserve":2}
```

marcus: try rolling patch to config and watch 30m.

deploy-bot: canary deploy started for sable21b-int4 on fleet/dedicated-gpu-us-east-2 (3 pods)

jing: also seeing KV churn in traces — need aggressive KV trim after generation. propose kv_trim_threshold_ms=10000

leo: agree. also enable soft-eviction for idle KV entries.

silvia: note: quality tests on samplers look good at 512 vs 1024, small diffs.

ada: plan: 1) deploy config changes, 2) monitor OOMs + latency for 2h, 3) if stable, gradual increase to 768 with adaptive prefetch cap. I'll open rollout ticket.

marcus: add an alert for memory-frag increase (p50->p95 swap) and OOM count >1 in 5min.

ada: thanks. ping me @channel if it spikes.

infra-bot: alert set: sable21b-int4 memory-frag delta monitor

jing: quick note: adding a temporary KV warmup throttle to stagger prefetch across replicas reduced fragmentation in local repro.

leo: if we still see tails, consider bumping allocator slab size to reduce fragmentation: slab_size_kb=64 -> 128

silvia: keeping an eye on eval regressions. so far no regression in rouge/bleu on eval suite.

ada: update in 90m with metrics. :rocket:

marcus: :thumbsup:
